what_to_test:
Juggle Dude 1.1.0 (35) — Pro invite codes and iOS 18 support

• Open Profile → Redeem invite code, or use the same button on the Pro screen. Check that Apple’s redemption sheet opens and that cancelling lets you continue using the app.
• Use an Apple sandbox offer code supplied for testing. Pro should unlock only after Apple verifies the transaction. Check Pro tools, relaunch and Restore purchases. Production offer codes are intended for the public App Store app, not TestFlight.
• Check leaderboard participation and longest counted streaks, Apple/email sign-in and changing app language without restarting.
• On iOS 18 or later, try recording, replay, ball replacement, effects, importing a video and saving to Photos. On iOS 18, keep the app open during video preparation/export; processing pauses when you leave and resumes when you return.

Known checks still needed: real offer-code redemption on a physical device, including cancellation and invalid/expired codes; physical iOS 18 camera, memory and thermal testing. The new invite-code text currently uses English.
